g.text: The ARM client feeds saved raw bytes through MMIO. The interpolation and mixing arithmetic execute in the FPGA fabric.

g.text: Register identity is part of admission
Magic 0x54524631 identifies TRF1. ABI is 0x00010000. Bits 31:16 of a raw
input write must be zero. Invalid accesses fault rather than reinterpret input.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65778a

g.text: The demonstrated capture uploads a RAM package and later downloads a
results archive. It is not the old audio TCP request/reply DSP service. Cycle
